title: Opting Out of Events in the Demand Response Programs
content:
**Opt-out terms.** In the Demand Response Programs, whether a customer may opt out of an event, how many opt-outs a season allows without consequence, and what follows when opt-outs exceed that number are set per program.

| Program | Customer may opt out of an event | Opt-outs per season without consequence | When opt-outs exceed the limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | No | 0 | Not applicable; participation in each event is voluntary and unrewarded when no reduction occurs |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | Yes | 3 | Seasonal incentive not earned for that season |
| AC Cycling Program | Yes | 2 | Enrollment removed at the end of the season |
| Home Battery Dispatch | Yes | 2 | Opted-out events count as zero delivered kW in the season average |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | No | 0 | Not applicable; under-delivery is charged as shortfall |
| Base Interruptible Program | No | 0 | Not applicable; usage above the firm service level is charged |

## Questions and answers on opt-outs

**May a Peak Time Rebate customer opt out of an event?** There is no opt-out in Peak Time Rebate. Participation in each event is voluntary, and an event in which no reduction occurs earns nothing.

**How many Smart Thermostat Rewards opt-outs does a season allow?** Three. With a fourth opt-out in the same season, the seasonal incentive is not earned for that season.

**What follows a third AC Cycling Program opt-out in one season?** The limit is two, so a third opt-out exceeds it, and the enrollment is removed at the end of the season.

**What does an excess opt-out do in Home Battery Dispatch?** The limit is two per season. Opted-out events beyond the limit count as zero delivered kW in the season average.

**Can a business customer opt out of an event?** No. In the Commercial Capacity Bidding Program under-delivery is charged as shortfall, and in the Base Interruptible Program usage above the firm service level is charged.

## Limit illustrations (hypothetical seasons)

| Program | Hypothetical opt-outs in the season | Exceeds the limit? |
|---|---|---|
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | 3 | No |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | 4 | Yes |
| AC Cycling Program | 2 | No |
| AC Cycling Program | 3 | Yes |
| Home Battery Dispatch | 2 | No |
| Home Battery Dispatch | 3 | Yes |
